Question 10
?

Find the equilibrium solutions of the differential equation dydx=y4+2.

a
y(x)=−24 only
b
y(x)=24 only
c
y1(x)=−24,y2(x)=0,y3(x)=1 and y4(x)=24
d
y1(x)=−24 and y2(x)=24
e
The equation has no equilibrium solutions
